notes: v1.0.93 - CRITICAL FIX: FPS Boost crashed on 26.2 instances with "Mixin config fpsboost.mixins.26_2.json specifies compatibility level ${COMPAT_LEVEL} which is not recognised". The mod build never expanded the compat_level placeholder in the 26.2-only mixins file (glob missed it). Fixed the glob, rebuilt both jars with the real JAVA_25 level, and the v1.0.92 hash-based auto-refresh swaps the fixed jar into every existing instance on its next launch automatically.
